scheme_name: Loan based Scheme for Pay and Use Community Toilets
other_conditions: Must be an Indian citizen aged 18 years or above.
Must belong to the Safai Karamcharis, manual scavengers or their dependents.
Individual beneficiaries or self‑help groups from the target group of NSKFDC are eligible.

Must be identified under the National Scheme for Liberation & Rehabilitation of Scavengers (NSLRS) or be registered in a co‑operative society, legally constituted association or firm of the target group.

May need to produce a certificate from the local Revenue Officer, Municipal Officer, Cantonment Executive Officer, Railway Officer, Head of a Government Department, elected municipal member, Pradhan of Gram Panchayat, or Regional Manager of Regional Rural Banks/Nationalised Bank, unless already listed as a manual scavenger in the final state/UT list.
benefits_summary: Provides collateral‑free loans up to ₹25 lakh at low interest for setting up and operating pay‑and‑use community toilets, enabling livelihood shift for Safai Karamcharis.
documents_required: Certificate from Head of Government Departments (Schools, Colleges, Forest, Health, Education, Animal Husbandry)
Certificate from elected members of Municipal Body
Certificate from Pradhan of Gram Panchayat
Certificate from Regional Manager of Regional Rural Banks/Nationalised Banks
